t: Are you drowning in gene samples? Are you getting RSI from combining genes? Then this block is for you!
你的基因样本是不是已经多到泛滥了？合成基因是不是合到手腕酸痛了？那这个方块就是为你准备的！

Fill up this extra big container with all the genes you have lying around, flip a switch and watch as the automated internal gene indexer thingy combines the genes for you. It might not be the most efficient way...but it's automated!$(br2)Needs a redstone signal.
把你手头所有零散的基因都塞进这个超大容器里，拨动开关，然后看着内部那个自动基因索引器帮你把基因组合起来。它或许不是最高效的方法……但它是自动化的！$(br2)需要红石信号。

Fill up this extra big container with all the genes you have lying around, flip a switch and watch as the automated internal gene indexer thingy combines the genes for you. It might not be the most efficient way...but it's automated!
Needs a redstone signal.

把手头攒着的基因一股脑塞进这个超大容器，扳一下开关，看着里面那套自动基因归档玩意儿替你合成。这法子未必最省事……但它是自动的！
需要红石信号。
